name: Hao Zheng
biography: Hao Zheng is a security researcher at TianGong Team of Legendsec at QI-ANXIN Group. His focus is on Virtualization Security, having submitted multiple security vulnerabilities to VMware. In 2023, he and his teammate successfully escaped the Parallels Desktop at GeekCon2023.
